## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install bookit in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure bookit package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to bookit
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/1iis/bookit):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/1iis/bookit.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/1iis/bookit)

``` sh
$ conda install -c 1iis bookit
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/bookit/)

``` sh
$ pip install bookit
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/1iis/bookit)’s
[pages](https://1iis.github.io/bookit/). Additionally you can find
package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/1iis/bookit) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/bookit/) respectively.
